purpose: Define a replay-safe DAG of attested governance states and compact epochs without creating a federal super-runtime.

STATE_EPOCH_NODE.meaning: A single replay-verified state governance epoch.

COMPACT_EPOCH_NODE.meaning: A replay-verified cross-state compact bound to participant state epochs.

FEDERATION_EPOCH_NODE.meaning: A replay-verified federated snapshot over included state and compact epoch nodes.

depends_on.meaning: Dependency relationship only; never mutation, rewrite, invalidation, or supersession.

acyclicity_rules: STATE_EPOCH nodes may not depend on COMPACT_EPOCH nodes.
COMPACT_EPOCH nodes may depend only on STATE_EPOCH nodes.
FEDERATION_EPOCH nodes may depend only on STATE_EPOCH or COMPACT_EPOCH nodes.
No node may depend on itself directly or indirectly.
verification_requirements: Every node replay verifier must pass before graph admission.
Every edge dependency target must exist in nodes.
No node or edge may imply cross-state baseline mutation.
Graph hashes must be recomputable from canonical nodes and edges.
invariants: No edge can rewrite an ancestor baseline.
Federation is a proof DAG, not a control plane.
No super-admin node exists in V1.
